text: The 2021 tree-cover loss of 81.3 ha (2.23% of the asset) was detected in a planted forest area, primarily consisting of *Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*. While the evidence confirms the loss occurred, it does not determine whether it was legal or illegal. The change could have been due to harvesting, natural causes, or other activities—none of which are specified. The data also does not identify responsible parties or assess compliance with regulations like the EUDR. Further investigation into local land-use policies and permits would be needed to determine legality.
